source: Deepwater qualified fields (DeepQualRawData) joined to the borehole API list (mv_api_list_all): one row per field code; WELLBORES counts API12 boreholes whose bottom field code is the field; WELLS_API10 counts distinct 10-digit API well numbers
publisher: US Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement
rule: Field water depth is BSEE's average field water depth in feet. DEV_* columns use BSEE well type D and are not used: the code is not set for every development well.

source: Borehole API list (mv_api_list_all): API12 boreholes by calendar year of spud date, US outer continental shelf, Gulf of America region
publisher: US Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement
rule: Year 2026 is part-year. Window used for the incident frequency: 1 Oct 2006 to 31 Dec 2023, 4748 boreholes (read in the same pass).

source: Drilling days (spud to total depth) and completion days (well activity report days after total depth) per wellbore, Anchor and Julia rows, copied unchanged from the repository's tabulated BSEE drilling and completion days (v21) for the US Gulf Lower Tertiary fields
publisher: US Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement
rule: The table records its coverage as unknown: a zero day count is a missing value, not a measured zero. Rows with zero days are not used.
